text:
Maya (All-Hands): Opening the live Q&A thread for the 'Customer wins/losses' segment. Drop concise Qs for leadership re: why we won/lost & top asks. We'll try to answer live and track follow-ups.

Jared (Sales): For the RetailCo win — curious what product thing sealed it? pricing? SLA? on-prem option?

Priya (Head of Product): Short answer: SLA + latency tail. We committed to a dedicated pool + predictable p95 after the pilot. Also our eval on their data showed 2x fewer hallucinations vs competitor (will share slides).

Miguel (AE): + their legal liked the VPC option. That was the tie breaker.

Anna (Customer Success): RetailCo also flagged our onboarding docs and on-call handoff as better than others. Good CS work :tada:

Jared (Sales): Thx. For the Enterprise loss last month (FinSys), does anyone have notes on why we lost?

Priya (Head of Product): FinSys — two main reasons: 1) model features they needed (specialized safety rules) were faster to integrate with CompetitorX, 2) their ops team couldn't accept our initial quantization constraints. We should own a clearer checklist for tough-regulated wins.

Evan (CEO): Adding — price wasn't the core issue there. Product fit + compliance integration speed was. We need a playbook for 'regulated verticals' wins/losses.

Anna (Customer Success): Action item: I'll work with Sales + Product to produce a 'Regulated Win Playbook' draft by EOW. Anyone want to co-own?

Miguel (AE): I can co-own. I have the FinSys RFP and notes.

Priya (Head of Product): Thanks — I'll add a checklist: required safety hooks, KMS/HSM questions, quantization tolerances, rollout timeline expectations. Also we'll publish model-variant compatibility matrix.

Jared (Sales): On top asks from customers — top 3 I'm hearing: 1) finer-grained SLA tiers, 2) better dev tooling for private deploys, 3) more pre-built evaluations for common verticals.

Priya (Head of Product): Agree. Re: dev tooling for private: Engineering is tracking a 'private quickstart' initiative. ETA Q3. We'll post a short RFC link in #product once ready.

Maya (All-Hands): Quick follow-up: leadership, will there be a short recap doc / action tracker from this thread so we can sync across teams?

Evan (CEO): Yes — Priya and Anna will own a shared doc and list of owners. We'll review in next All-Hands.

ops-bot: Reminder: Meeting notes form created — fill it here: <https://docs.redwood.com/teams/all-hands/customer-feedback-wins-losses>

Maya (All-Hands): Great — thanks everyone. If you have additional customer-specific details, drop them here or ping Anna/Miguel directly. :thumbsup:
